name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is the largest release since v0.4.0, spanning 238 commits. Highlights include 'Connect Knowledge' for read-only cloud drive access (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox) per room without OAuth setup, a greatly expanded Integrations Hub with 52 connectors (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and a new Telegram remote-control gateway for running agents. The release also delivers agent Channels (renamed from .slack to .channels on disk), clean-path routing replacing hash-based URLs, PBKDF2 password hashing with login rate-limiting, and numerous editor, task, and Windows fixes. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits since v0.4.0
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, mobile and reverse-proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app now serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but the canonical form is path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more advanced document management with OCR, tagging, and full-text search, but is significantly heavier to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and metadata, but requires more setup and resources compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automatic document classification and processing pipelines, but has a steeper learning curve and more complex architecture than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted cloud platform that far exceeds Cabinet in features like collaboration and apps, but is considerably heavier and more complex to maintain.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focuses on file browsing across multiple storage backends, but lacks Cabinet's document-centric organization and management features.
